name: Demon Of Despair
description: A cloaked demon-creature with long limbs, seeping shadows.

abilities.name: Depths of Despair
abilities.description: The Demon deals double damage to PCs with 0 Hope.

abilities.name: Your Struggle Is Pointless
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to weigh down the spirits of all PCs within Far range. All targets affected replace their Hope Die with a d8 until they roll a success with Hope or their next rest.

abilities.name: Your Friends Will Fail You
abilities.description: When a PC fails with Fear, you can mark a Stress to cause all other PCs within Close range to lose a Hope.

abilities.name: Momentum
abilities.description: When the Demon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.
